title: Schedule of Service Charges, Meter Test Fee Footnote: Refund of Test Fees after a Fast Meter on Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Footnote to the meter test fee.** When an Electric Service by Rate Schedule meter is found fast and the member is refunded, meter test fees already charged on the same service account are refunded as follows:

| Meter test fees on the account | Test fee refund |
|---|---|
| One or more meter test fees dated in the rebill window | Those fees in full |
| None in the rebill window, but meter test fees dated less than 6 whole months before the current date (the schedule's maximum number of corrected billing periods, 6 on all seven schedules) | 0.50 of those earlier fees, rounded to the cent |
| None dated less than 6 whole months before the current date | Nothing |

**Order.** The test fee refund is added last, after any overbilling interest on the refund, and the total credit is rounded to the cent; the test fee refund itself earns no interest.

### Hypothetical cases (rebill window of 4 whole months; Schedule R test fee $40.00)

| Meter test fee dated | Test fee refund |
|---|---|
| 2 months before the current date (in the window) | $40.00 |
| 5 whole months before the current date (outside the window, inside 6 whole months) | $20.00 |
| 7 whole months before the current date | Nothing |

### Points of reading

- "Earlier fees" are the meter test fees dated less than 6 whole months before the current date that fall outside the rebill window.
- When the rebill window itself is 6 whole months, every fee inside 6 whole months is in the window and is refunded in full.
